---
title: "Share an Idea"
subtitle: "A simple way to contribute before the BENQODHI workshop"
body-class: contribution-page
---

Before the workshop, participants can leave short ideas to help shape the discussion
at JRC Ispra. One idea is enough: a candidate benchmark problem, a suggestion for the
working session, a panel question, or a practical note about datasets, metrics or
baselines.

::: {.idea-actions}
[Submit an idea](https://github.com/ocadni/benqodhi/issues/new?template=workshop-contribution.yml){.primary-action}
[Read submitted ideas](https://github.com/ocadni/benqodhi/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aworkshop-idea){.secondary-action}
:::

Ideas are collected as public GitHub Issues. Choose the closest type:
**candidate problem**, **session organisation**, **panel question**,
**dataset/baseline/metric**, or **other**.

If GitHub is inconvenient, send your idea by email:
[JRC-F7-CONFERENCES@ec.europa.eu](mailto:JRC-F7-CONFERENCES@ec.europa.eu)

## Example Ideas

::: {.example-ideas}
::: {.example-idea}
### Radiotherapy planning as a benchmark problem

Radiotherapy treatment planning is a concrete health optimization problem that could
be discussed as a BENQODHI benchmark. Useful notes would include objectives,
constraints, available instances, baselines and evaluation metrics.
:::

::: {.example-idea}
### Day 2 working-table structure

The Day 2 morning session could be organised around three provisional tables:
bioinformatics, health problems, and machine learning or quantum/benchmark practice.
Participants can suggest different tables, additional themes or a simpler format.
:::
:::

If your idea is a candidate benchmark problem, please mention:

- what the biological or health use case is,
- what needs to be optimized,
- what data or instances might be available,
- why the problem is hard or interesting,
- which baselines or metrics could be useful.

Partial sketches are welcome.
